//: One API docs section per product (.cursor/rules/product-docs-suites.mdc). Platform is the Mintlify site moved here; each self-serve product is its own section inside that product's Help Center suite (`base`), with its own guides (src/api-docs/<key>/) and its own spec (src/data/api/products/<key>/openapi.json; `tab` and `sourceDir` record where they came from in the retired lennd/sessionboard-public-api-docs). `released: false` keeps a product out of every build unless SB_PREVIEW_SUITES names it (`1`/`all` = every product), the same rule and values as the Help Center suites (src/data/suites.json); when that file lands on main, src/lib/api-docs/products.mjs should read `released` from it instead. `help` is where the Help Center tab points from that product's API pages. Order is the switcher's order.
